topics.titleEn: Database Schema Design: A Practical Guide
topics.angle: guide + design a relational schema that stays fast and sane as the product grows
topics.brief: Field-notes guide (pairs with our indexing and migrations posts). Sections: modeling entities and relationships; normalization up to 3NF and when to denormalize deliberately; keys, constraints and foreign keys as correctness guarantees; choosing types (UUID vs bigint, timestamps, enums vs lookup tables); soft deletes, audit columns and JSONB pitfalls; evolving schemas safely. Key claims to verify: constraints prevent whole bug classes; premature denormalization hurts more than it helps; JSONB is powerful but easy to overuse. Sources: PostgreSQL docs; database design references. End with a schema-review checklist.

topics.angle: checklist + run credible on-call and incident response without a big SRE org
topics.brief: Contrarian checklist for teams without a dedicated SRE org. Sections: lightweight on-call that doesn't burn people out; severity levels and a single incident commander; the first 15 minutes (stabilize, communicate, don't debug blindly); blameless postmortems and action items that actually ship; alert hygiene to kill fatigue. Key claims to verify: blameless postmortems improve reliability more than blame; alert fatigue and noisy paging cause missed real incidents; small teams need process, just lighter. Sources: Google SRE book chapters; incident-management guides. End with an incident runbook template.
